name: Stage 6:1: Huddinge stn to Hökärr (etapp 6)
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 6:1, Huddinge stn to Hökärr (etapp 6).
utilities: Official area: Botkyrka kommun, Huddinge kommun, Stockholm.
Huddinge station and centrum provide commuter rail, bus terminal, shops, restaurants, toilets, and paid commuter/centrum parking at the start.

Several bus-access/bailout options exist before the forest deepens, including Sörskogen, Visättra sportcenter, Gladö Kvarn/Kvarnsjön, and Lidavägen/Hökärrsvägen area stops; check current SL departures.

The Hökärr endpoint is a junction with Etapp 6 at about 59.164973, 17.967248, not a convenient station finish. Plan a pickup, walk out 2.5-3 km to a bus, or continue on Etapp 6 toward Lida or Paradiset.

Visättra sportcenter has opening-hour-dependent toilets and hockey-season cafe context, and OSM maps a nearby water tap, but none of that should be treated as dependable trail infrastructure without live/local verification.
Nyboviksbadet and Affärsviken at Kvarnsjön offer useful off-route bathing/toilet/parking context in season, but they are detours or side-access points and bathing water is not a potable refill.

Flemingsberg station/centrum and Visättra shops can work as urban bailout or resupply before the wilder southern half. After Visättra/Flemingsberg, no reliable shop or public toilet was verified through Gladö kvarn, Nytorp, Kärrsjön, or Hökärr.

Hökärrsvägen, Gladö Kvarn, and Kvarnsjön stops appear in side-access material around the Gladö/Kvarnsjön area, commonly with SL 744 references, but source naming varies. Verify the exact stop and line in the SL app the same day.
waterSources: Scoutstugan Nytorp pump is the official water point after about 10 km, but scout-cottage information says the hand-pump water is for washing dishes/hands, quality is not guaranteed, it can be brownish, and users should bring drinking water. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup even though OSM maps it as a manual drinking-water pump.
An OSM-mapped water tap near Visättra sportcenter may exist, but it is not an official Stage 6:1 water source and should be verified on site before relying on it.
The old Trefaldighetskällan above Mariedalsvägen is explicitly described by Sörmlandsleden as dry and should not be mapped as water.

Kvarnsjön and Kärrsjön are natural lake water only; treat/filter/boil if used and carry enough from Huddinge. Kärrsjön is muddy/not good for bathing according to Stage 6 context and should not be presented as a swimming or drinking-water source.
Orlången/Flemingsbergsviken has documented poor water-quality context in Huddinge material and should never be presented as a drinking-water source.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Urban-to-forest access connector from Huddinge station to Hökärr/stage 6, officially 13 km. Official Sörmlandsleden page metadata was checked as modified 2025-10-14 and showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 pass. OSM and third-party lengths vary between roughly 12.7 and 14 km, while some blogs include extra continuation/access distance; treat line length as approximate and follow current orange markings.

For route drawing, use the cleaned continuous OSM/Naturkartan chain from Huddinge station/start to the Hökärr/Etapp 6 shared node at about 59.164973, 17.967248. OSM relation 2343843 has a stale 14 km tag: raw member sum is about 13.75 km because it includes noisy/dangling members, while the connected routable line with a tiny Visättra snap gap measures about 13.04 km and matches the official/Naturkartan 13 km.

Stage 6:1 is an access connector, not a normal continuation in the main chain. In the route builder, offer it when the user selects or approaches Hökärr/Etapp 6, and keep onward Stage 6 choices toward Lida and Paradiset separate.

Official description is easy walking on mixed roads and lightly hilly terrain, then rockier forest near Nytorp, Kvarnsjöberget, Kärrsjön, and Valtertummaberget. Recent 2025 user reports describe the stage as well marked and maintained, but winter and freeze-thaw conditions can be very icy; microspikes/broddar are sensible in winter/early spring.

The route crosses or touches several Huddinge reserves including Flemingsbergsskogen, Orlången, Gladö Kvarnsjön, and Gladöskogen. Dogs should be leashed in protected areas; national 1 March-20 August dog-control rules also apply. Orlången, Gladö Kvarnsjön, and Gladöskogen prohibit camping more than two consecutive nights in the same place, while Flemingsbergsskogen still requires low-impact allemansrätten practice where not otherwise signed.

Reserve rules commonly prohibit fires on bare rock/cliffs and damaging live or dead wood. Use only established fireplaces where allowed, check current fire bans and grass-fire risk, and do not assume public firewood. Scoutstugan/Nytorp fireplaces and toilets belong to booked scout-facility context unless signs say otherwise.
No official shelter or dependable on-route toilet is listed for 6:1. Huddinge centrum/start services and optional Etapp 6 continuation services are the practical utility nodes.

Recent official comment in 2025 says joining at Flemingsberg worked well and the trail was very well marked. Older trip reports describe icy/slippery winter conditions, mud/snow, old storm-fallen trees, and some ambiguity around Gladö Kvarn/construction/horse paths; treat as seasonal/local caution, not a current closure.

Gladö Kvarn/Kvarnsjön is a known navigation-attention area: older reports describe losing the trail near the mill/road transition, and OSM relation 2343843 has a dangling Kvarnvägen/Gladövägen member. Use current orange markings over raw relation fragments.

Fishing in Huddinge lakes generally requires the correct fishing card, with exceptions not relevant here. Keep this warning around Orlången, Kvarnsjön, and Kärrsjön, and note that eating fish from Orlången should be approached cautiously because Huddinge has measured pollutants and advises caution where fresh measurements are missing.

Kvarnsjön Gladö fishing is not generally open to hikers; sources describe it as restricted to the local fishing-association members, and motor-driven boats are prohibited. Keep this as rule context around the lake rather than a recreation recommendation.

Kärrsjön firepit, tent/rest context, and former Kvarnsjön shelter belong to adjacent Stage 6 planning around the Hökärr junction. Show them as continuation context, not as core Stage 6:1 shelter infrastructure. The former Kvarnsjön spring on Stage 6 has contradictory dry/wet reports from 2024-2026 and should remain seasonal/unreliable.

facilities.name: Huddinge station trail start
facilities.description: Official start with commuter rail, bus terminal, and town services. Stockholm City-Huddinge is a short commuter-rail trip when service is running.

facilities.name: Huddinge station toilets
facilities.description: Paid/managed station-area toilets mapped near the start; Huddinge centrum also lists an accessible public toilet. Verify opening/access before relying on them.

facilities.name: Huddinge centrum additional public toilet
facilities.description: Additional paid/managed toilet mapped in Huddinge centrum. Verify opening/access before relying on it.

facilities.name: Huddinge centrum services
facilities.description: Start-area shops, cafes, restaurants, pharmacy, and other opening-hour-dependent services.

facilities.name: Huddinge centrum parking
facilities.description: Centrum/commuter parking near the start; check fees, max stay, and current local rules.

facilities.name: Forellgaraget / Huddinge centrum parking
facilities.description: Additional Huddinge centrum parking option near the rail/bus start. Check fees, max stay, and commuter-parking rules.

facilities.name: Sörskogen info board
facilities.description: Official information/access board on the connector.

facilities.name: Sörskogen bus access
facilities.description: Neighborhood bus access near the route; check current SL service.

facilities.name: Trefaldighetskällan dry spring
facilities.description: Cultural/historic spring above Mariedalsvägen; Sörmlandsleden says it is now dry, so this is not a water source. Approximate pin.

facilities.name: Flemingsbergsviken / Orlången water warning
facilities.description: Scenic wetland/lake-shore context near the route, not drinking water. Huddinge material rates Orlången poorly for water quality; carry water and avoid contaminating the shore.

facilities.name: Stensättra / Flemingsbergsviken hillfort area
facilities.description: One of several ancient hillfort contexts near Flemingsbergsviken/Brodal mentioned along the stage; treat as protected look-but-do-not-disturb heritage.

facilities.name: Visättra info board
facilities.description: Official information/access board on the connector.

facilities.name: Visättra sportcenter services
facilities.description: Optional nearby sport-center services; Naturkartan lists toilets when the sportcenter is open and cafe during hockey season. Not guaranteed trail facilities.

facilities.name: Visättra sportcenter bus access
facilities.description: Bus access near the Visättra part of the route; check current SL service.

facilities.name: Visättra sportcenter mapped water tap
facilities.description: OSM-mapped drinking-water tap near Visättra sportcenter. Not verified by official Stage 6:1 sources; treat as seasonal/access-dependent and carry backup.

facilities.name: Flemingsberg station bailout
facilities.description: Practical off-route rail/bus access from the Visättra/Flemingsbergsskogen area. A 2025 comment said joining at Flemingsberg worked well and was clearly marked.

facilities.name: Flemingsberg centrum resupply and toilets
facilities.description: Off-route urban bailout/resupply cluster with station, shops, and mapped toilets around Flemingsberg centrum/ICA/Lidl/Pressbyrån. Useful before the forested half, but not a trail facility.

facilities.name: Former Stenberg croft remains
facilities.description: Former croft area mentioned by official route text; nearby mapped rest/fireplace points should still be used only where allowed.

facilities.name: Flemingsbergsskogen / Svartkällan grill site
facilities.description: Mapped grill/rest site with benches/table context near the route. Use only if local reserve rules and current fire-ban status allow it; no firewood guarantee.

facilities.name: Former Stensberg croft grill site
facilities.description: Grill/rest context at old croft remains near Flemingsbergsskogen. Use only established fireplaces and obey fire-ban/reserve rules.

facilities.name: Visättra/Stenberg fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped BBQ/fireplace near the route. Use only if locally permitted and current fire-ban status allows it.

facilities.name: Gladö kvarn ruins
facilities.description: Route passes remains of Gladö kvarn, with origins mentioned by official text as far back as the 1300s. OSM-derived coordinate.

facilities.name: Gladö/Lidavägen route-variant caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 2343843 includes a dangling path member toward Kvarnvägen/Gladövägen, and older reports mention confusing passage around Gladö kvarn. Follow current orange markings over stale relation fragments.

facilities.name: Stage 6:1 OSM distance caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 2343843 is tagged 14 km and has a tiny Visättra split plus a dangling Gladö/Kvarnsjön-area member. The cleaned connected line measures about 13.04 km, matching official/Naturkartan 13 km.

facilities.name: Lidavägen / Kvarnsjön bus access
facilities.description: Bus access/bailout near the road-walking and Gladö/Kvarnsjön part of the stage; check current SL service.

facilities.name: Gladö Kvarn bus access
facilities.description: SL side access near Gladö Kvarn/Nybovik/Kvarnsjön. OSM and local pages commonly point to route 744, but verify live departures and stop names in SL before relying on it.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjön bus access
facilities.description: SL side access near Kvarnsjön/Gladö Kvarn. Useful bailout or join point, but not the Hökärr trail junction; verify live service.

facilities.name: Hökärrsvägen bus access caveat
facilities.description: Legacy/secondary access text points to Hökärrsvägen for the Gladö/Kvarnvägen/Scoutstugan side, but current SL timetable naming can be confusing. Verify live; this is not the Hökärr stage junction and requires extra walking.

facilities.name: Gladö Kvarnsjön reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve and lake-use context: dogs are leashed where required, fires only where permitted and never on bare rock/cliffs, camping max two nights in one place, Kvarnsjön fishing is restricted, and motor-driven boats are prohibited.

facilities.name: Huddinge lake fishing-card warning
facilities.description: Fishing in Huddinge lakes generally requires the correct fishing card. Also treat fish-consumption advice cautiously around Orlången and other lakes where pollutants or missing recent measurements are noted.

facilities.name: Kvarnvägen reserve parking
facilities.description: Visitor parking near Kvarnvägen/Gladö Kvarnsjön reserve access. Do not drive past private or restricted booms without permission.

facilities.name: Kvarnvägen 100 scout barrier access
facilities.description: Scout-source parking/access coordinate by a locked barrier, about 1.3 km from Scoutstugan Nytorp by gravel/forest road. Not a public overnight-parking promise.

facilities.name: Scoutstugan Nytorp pump
facilities.description: Official pump after about 10 km. Scout-cottage information says the hand pump is for washing dishes/hands, quality is not guaranteed, water can be brownish, and drinking water should be brought; treat/filter/boil or carry backup.

facilities.name: Scoutstugan Nytorp facility caveat
facilities.description: Scoutstugan Nytorp has rental/group-facility context, including privies, fireplace/campfire infrastructure, jetty/playground, and cottage utilities, but it is not a public hiker hut or official free shelter. Do not assume access unless signs or booking permit it.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjön natural water
facilities.description: Natural lake water along the route; not a potable refill. Treat/filter/boil if used.

facilities.name: Nyboviksbadet Kvarnsjön detour
facilities.description: Off-route bathing area with seasonal toilet/changing/parking context and monitored bathing water. This is not potable water and requires a detour from Stage 6:1.

facilities.name: Affärsviken bathing and toilet side access
facilities.description: Small Kvarnsjön bathing place/side access with rocks, small beach/grass area, parking/bike context, benches/play equipment, and toilets including accessible toilet reported by bathing-place sources. Off-route and not potable water.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjöberget high point
facilities.description: Kvarnsjöberget/trig-point area mentioned by official text near Nytorp; approximate route-interest pin.

facilities.name: Seasonal ice, mud, and marking caution
facilities.description: Hiker reports describe very icy/slippery winter or early-spring forest where broddar/microspikes were strongly preferred, plus mud/snow and occasional Gladö Kvarn navigation ambiguity. Seasonal caution, not a current closure.

facilities.name: Kärrsjön area firepit
facilities.description: Stage 6 continuation context near/after the Hökärr junction: simple benches and an open fireplace are described around Kärrsjön. Use only if locally permitted and current fire-ban status allows it; Kärrsjön is muddy/not good for bathing.

facilities.name: Hökärr / Etapp 6 junction
facilities.description: Connector endpoint and Stage 6 shared node. From here, Stage 6 continues toward Lida in one direction and Paradiset in the other; do not rely on left/right wording without map orientation. Not a convenient transit finish.

facilities.name: Former Kvarnsjön spring continuation caveat
facilities.description: Stage 6 continuation water near the former Kvarnsjön shelter, not core Stage 6:1. User reports conflict: dry in 2024/2025, water present in January 2026. Treat as seasonal/unreliable.
